messages:
alex_cheng: Heads up — CloudBox marketplace entitlements showing as STALE in our ledger. Noticed after midnight batch, ~10% of partner-entitlement keys haven't received heartbeats in 2h. This could affect billing visibility. :eyes:

maria_garcia: Ugh. Seen any pattern? regions, SKUs?

alex_cheng: Mostly eu-west-1 and ap-southeast-1. SKUs spread across hourly/minutely. Dashboard: https://dash.reddev/partners/cloudbox/entitlements (internal)

sam_irwin: dug in — their webhook acks started failing around 2026-03-23T00:12Z. Error is 502 from our ingest-proxy. Quick query I ran:

sam_irwin: SELECT partner_id, count(*) FROM partner_ingest.errors WHERE partner='cloudbox' AND ts > now() - interval '3h' GROUP BY partner_id;

sam_irwin: result: 4 hostnames showing 502 spikes, correlated with proxy autoscaler event.

tara_ops: Can we force-reconcile entitlements so customer-facing usage doesn't get marked missing? Runbook step: /runbook reconcile-entitlements --partner cloudbox --since 3h

alex_cheng: @tara_ops please run it, but we should also pause any billing runs until we confirm reconciliation. I'll open a billing hold ticket.

partner_bot: [automated] marketplace-heartbeat-service reported 3 failed regions for partner=cloudbox; last success=2026-03-23T00:05Z. Incident created: INC-20260323-1100

maria_garcia: tagging CloudBox PM (cc @cloudbox-integration) — can you confirm if they did any deploys? We need their SLA window info.

sam_irwin: quick mitigation: I can roll the ingest-proxy to previous revision with no downtime risk. Will do a canary now and monitor.

tara_ops: Reconcile job kicked at 00:45Z. Progress: processed 1.2k entitlements, 98% matched automatically, 15 entries flagged for manual review.

alex_cheng: Manual review list looks like mismatched namespace keys (old sku IDs). Keeping this thread for coordination. Action items:
- sam_irwin: finish proxy rollback and confirm 24h of stable acks
- tara_ops: complete manual review and post reconciliation report
- maria_garcia: coordinate billing hold + partner comms
- alex_cheng: follow up with CloudBox PM on deploy timeline

maria_garcia: I'm drafting the partner message. Will include a request for webhook retry logs and exact deploy timestamps. :memo:

sam_irwin: proxy rollback done, canary 20% for 15m with no 502s. Scaling back up now.

partner_bot: [automated] reconcile job completed at 2026-03-23T01:12Z. Summary: 1.2k processed, 15 manual, credits prevented=~$4.2k. :white_check_mark:

tara_ops: manual review mostly resolved; 5 remain (old sku -> mapping required). Filing a follow-up ticket to update sku canonicalization.

alex_cheng: Thanks all. I'll wait for CloudBox reply before releasing billing hold. If no reply in 4h, escalate to partnerships leadership. :thumbsup:
